## PR6 CI infrastructure recovery

Attempt 1 of run 37364731059 failed before executing any steps: GitHub's authenticated check annotation says, "The job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted even after multiple attempts". Job 111947076004 had runner_id 0, empty runner_name and zero steps. This identifies hosted-runner acquisition failure, not a code-test failure; the annotations contain no user-cancellation indication. The branch run inventory contained no active duplicate.

Following the coordinator's explicit authorization, I requested exactly one rerun of the same run/head. Attempt 2 acquired a hosted runner and is now **success**. [Run and checks](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37364731059/attempts/2). No further rerun was requested.

Source remains 2be85f0cb02cd5ba464f46c623b9b19cf5061231; master/base remains 5d72992c77fbb09195518e257d799501b7db4d04; exact PR body SHA-256 remains 2fe5278a6f2294df4b46fa2016e05f469a143f0a054d82b65bfc50267e9628f2. No source, PR description, billing, quotas, credentials, protections or CI gates changed; PR13 was untouched. Original and recovery API evidence is retained under docs/review/pr6-catalog-cancel on evidence/pr6-final-zbook. Full authenticated GitHub-page inspection and independent QA remain outstanding; no readiness is awarded. Writer is idle.
